name: quickflow-ecommerce-fulfillment-network

scripts.engine:build: cd cpp-engine && g++ -std=c++14 -I. main.cpp domain/*.cpp warehouse/*.cpp core/*.cpp routing/*.cpp pipeline/*.cpp observer/*.cpp simulation/*.cpp demo/*.cpp -o quickflow_engine.exe
scripts.engine:test: cd cpp-engine && g++ -std=c++14 -I. tests/unit_tests.cpp domain/*.cpp warehouse/*.cpp core/*.cpp routing/*.cpp pipeline/*.cpp observer/*.cpp simulation/*.cpp demo/*.cpp -o quickflow_tests.exe && .\quickflow_tests.exe
